Title: Verify new user can register with valid mandatory details
Preconditions: User is on the Toolshop home page and not logged in
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to /auth/register 2. Fill first name, last name, DOB, address, phone, email, password 3. Click Register
Expected Result: User is redirected to the login page with a 'registration successful' message; a new user record exists in the system

Title: Verify sign out clears the session and returns user to a signed-out state
Preconditions: User is logged in as customer@practicesoftwaretesting.com
Test Steps: 1. Open the account menu 2. Click 'Sign out'
Expected Result: User is redirected to the home page; 'Sign in' link is visible again; protected pages (e.g. /account/profile) redirect back to login

Title: Verify login is rejected with an unregistered email address
Preconditions: User is on the login page
Test Steps: 1. Enter an email that has never been registered 2. Enter any password 3. Click Login
Expected Result: An 'invalid credentials' error is shown; user remains on the login page and is not authenticated

Title: Verify a product can be added to the cart with quantity greater than 1
Preconditions: User is logged in and viewing a product detail page
Test Steps: 1. Increase quantity to 3 using the quantity stepper 2. Click 'Add to cart' 3. Open the cart
Expected Result: Cart shows the product with quantity 3 and a line total = unit price x 3

Title: Verify checkout via Cash on Delivery generates an invoice visible under My Invoices
Preconditions: User is logged in with at least one item in the cart
Test Steps: 1. Proceed to checkout 2. Confirm shipping address 3. Select 'Cash on Delivery' 4. Click Confirm (press Confirm a second time - required on this environment) 5. Open 'My Invoices'
Expected Result: An invoice with a unique invoice number is created and appears in My Invoices with status AWAITING_FULFILLMENT (or equivalent)

Title: Verify the cart total updates correctly when an item is removed
Preconditions: User has 2 different products in the cart
Test Steps: 1. Note the current cart total 2. Remove one product line from the cart 3. Observe the updated total
Test Data: Two in-stock products with different prices
Expected Result: Removed product line disappears; cart total recalculates to reflect only the remaining item(s)

Title: Verify an out-of-stock product cannot be added to the cart
Preconditions: An out-of-stock product exists in the catalog
Test Steps: 1. Open an out-of-stock product's detail page 2. Attempt to add it to the cart
Test Data: Out-of-stock product (e.g. filtered via API by stock=0)
Expected Result: 'Add to cart' is disabled/hidden and an 'Out of stock' indicator is shown; item cannot be added

Title: Verify product search returns only relevant results and handles no-match gracefully
Preconditions: User is on the home page
Test Steps: 1. Search for a known product keyword (e.g. 'Hammer') 2. Verify results 3. Search for a nonsense keyword (e.g. 'zzznotaproduct')
Expected Result: Step 2: only products matching the keyword are shown. Step 3: a 'no products found' state is shown, no application error
